recipes.matchedUserPrelude:
[Studio — Propose DCO blog (author URL)]
1. **FetchHttpUrl** once on the author’s pasted URL only — no **ResearchSiteContent**, **WebSearch**, or **SerpApiWebSearch**.
2. In your **last** assistant message (after tools finish), you **must** include a **## Draft body** section with:
   - `Author voice: **…**` (from project / site author context)
   - `*Draft title:*` …
   - `*Outline:*` (bullets — one per topic the author named)
   - `*Draft blog:*` then the **full article** (at least 6 paragraphs), grounded in the fetch
3. Cover **every** topic the author listed — do not substitute unrelated generic filler unrelated to those topics.
4. Also include **## root** (short pitch) and **## craftercmsAlignment** (bullets). Put the long article **only** under **## Draft body** / `*Draft blog:*`, not only in Slack-bound fields.
5. **Do not** call **SlackPostMessage** in **tool_calls** — confirmation runs Slack on the server.

context: Author pasted a source URL and named specific topics. Treat those topics as mandatory sections in the draft.
action: **Required in your final assistant markdown:** a **## Draft body** section containing `*Draft title:*`, `*Outline:*`, and `*Draft blog:*` followed by the complete blog prose. Without `*Draft blog:*` and full paragraphs, a follow-up **Make a post from this draft** cannot create repository content.
Optional **## root** and **## craftercmsAlignment** for pitch/alignment; keep them short.
Do not end the turn with only a one-line tools status or an empty **## draft** header.

hints: **draft** for Slack is copied from **## Draft body** in the assistant turn (passthrough). Short Slack fields come from **llmRefine** JSON. Five **SlackPostMessage** steps use **$slackOutbound.*** — do not call them in **tool_calls**.

draft: **draft** (own Slack thread reply): Start `✏️ Draft · voice: **…**` (one voice from project context, bold). Then `*Draft title:*`, `*Outline:*` (one bullet per topic the author named in their request), then `*Draft blog:*` followed by the **full** article (8+ paragraphs) grounded in the fetched page.
Use only facts supported by the author request and the fetched URL. **Forbidden:** generic filler unrelated to the author’s named topics.

engineSteps.userPreamble: From the assistant turn below, produce **four** Slack mrkdwn bodies: **root**, **craftercmsAlignment**, **pitch**, **sources** only. (**draft** is copied separately from **## Draft body**.) Today is **{{studio.today}}**.
hints: **root**: `💡 New Blog Pitch:` + title; `✍️ Author voice:`; `📋 Summary:` one paragraph on why this topic now.
**pitch**: hook, audience, angle, why now — one label per line.
**sources**: `🔗 Sources` with the author URL and any citations from research.
Do not put the full article in root — long copy belongs in **draft** passthrough only.

recipes.title: Create DCO post from prior chat
recipes.description: Turn 2: save the prior assistant article from chat as a new `/component/post` (e.g. “make a post”, “save this” — no “draft” wording required). See **Project authoring context** for XML shape.
recipes.matchedUserPrelude:
[Studio — create repository item from prior chat draft — fast path]

**Prefetch (done):** form defs, taxonomy XML, bio catalog, sibling XML shape, **suggestedNewItemPath**, server **ContentExists** on that path.

**API tool_calls only (required):** Do **not** use markdown `functions.WriteContent(...)` or fenced JSON stubs. Round 1: native **tool_calls** → **ContentExists** with `path` = **suggestedNewItemPath** from prefetch JSON (or your chosen slug if exists=true). Round 2: native **tool_calls** → **WriteContent** with the **same** `contentPath` and full **contentXml** from **[Prior conversation]** + prefetch.

**Mandatory in contentXml:** verbatim draft title/body; required SEO fields per project context; node-selector paths only from prefetch catalog (UUID `.xml` filenames).

**Topics / tags:** From prefetch `taxonomyTopics` / `taxonomyTags`, assign keys that reasonably match the draft — omit when nothing fits; never copy sibling topics/tags verbatim. For taxonomy items use `<value_smv>` (not `<value>`), mirroring sibling `/component/post` shape.

**Path rule:** `contentPath` and `<file-name>` must share the same basename. If **ContentExists** is **true** on the suggested slug, pick a new slug where exists=false and use it in **both** places.

**Tools loop:** **ContentExists** then **WriteContent** once — **no** GetContentTypeFormDefinition, ResearchSiteContent, or ListStudioContentTypes (prefetch already ran them).

hints: Title and body: last **Assistant** reply in **[Prior conversation]** — copy verbatim (see project context).

Match **Author voice:** to a prefetch bio row by **displayName** (Studio internal-name from search). Copy that row's full `.xml` path into `authorBio_o` — UUID file names only; never `sara.xml` or other invented slugs.
`pageDescription_s` and `blurb_t`: first sentence of `*Draft blog:*` (meta ≤250 chars, blurb ≤150 chars).

Topics/tags: from prefetch `taxonomyTopics` / `taxonomyTags`, pick keys that reasonably match the draft title+body. Omit the field if nothing fits — do not copy sibling topics/tags or pad with unrelated keys. Use `<value_smv>` for taxonomy item labels (not `<value>`).

action: Read the **last Assistant** reply in **[Prior conversation]** for title and full article body. If that reply has no saveable article, stop — do not **WriteContent**.

From prefetch only: map **authorBio_o** from `authorBios` + **Author voice:** (real `.xml` path); **categories_o** / **tags_o** from taxonomy prefetch when they reasonably match the draft (omit if none), and write taxonomy labels as `<value_smv>` entries; **pageDescription_s** from the draft opening sentence; XML shape from `postForm`, `richTextForm`, sibling + project context.
Build **contentXml** (verbatim draft). **ContentExists** on your new path (must be **false**) → **WriteContent** once. Write verification rejects incomplete XML — fix and retry.
confirmation: Confirm path. In Studio, **Content** must match the prior assistant draft length — not a shortened rewrite.
